question: What exact typed relation does an MTS proof artifact certify before any new inference rule is considered?

models.name: formula-is-globally-true
models.reason: Current MTS contracts define contextual operations and local constraints, not a context-free global truth predicate over every Expression.

models.name: global-equality-theorem-database
models.reason: Accepted equality is local contextual unification and successful definition opening does not assert A = F.

models.name: typed-operation-claim
models.reason: A claim can certify an exact result of an already accepted canonical read-only operation under explicit replay inputs without inventing truth, rewrite or hidden state.

models.name: textual-rewrite-reachability
models.reason: Global textual substitution and recursive normalization are outside accepted definition/equality semantics.

models.name: generic-inference-dag-before-judgment
models.reason: Step composition cannot be defined soundly before the type and replay meaning of one claim are fixed.
